mechanics.claim: Casting Astral Flight resets Breath of Light's cooldown and, during flight, Breath of Light has no cooldown and its non-burst flat damage is increased.
mechanics.quote: resets ''{{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}. During flight, he has {{tip|unobstructed vision}} and ''{{ai|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}}'' has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its non-burst flat damage is increased

mechanics.claim: Astral Flight's dash speed is reduced by 50% while channeling Breath of Light during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''Astral Flight's'' dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel

mechanics.claim: Aurelion Sol can cast any of his other abilities during the Astral Flight dash.
mechanics.quote: He can cast any of his abilities during the dash

mechanics.claim: Breath of Light's channel is interrupted if Astral Flight ends or Singularity/R is cast during the flight, but it is automatically recast afterward.
mechanics.quote: {{ais|Breath of Light|Aurelion Sol}} channel will be interrupted if Astral Flight ends or {{ai|Singularity|Aurelion Sol}} or {{ai|Falling Star|Aurelion Sol}} / {{ai|The Skies Descend|Aurelion Sol}} is cast during the flight, but the ability will automatically be cast afterwards

mechanics.claim: Astral Flight can be recast to end the dash early, and does so automatically upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: ''Astral Flight'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the dash, and does so automatically upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Scoring a takedown within 3 seconds of damaging a target reduces Astral Flight's current cooldown by 90% of its total cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them reduces ''Astral Flight's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 90% of its '''total''' cooldown

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on the post-effect (after the dash/channel ends), not on cast.
Astral Flight cannot be used in the first 15 seconds of the game.
mechanics.quote: ''Astral Flight'' cannot be used in the first 15 seconds of the game.
